en_title: The Witcher 4 Will Have a Comparable Leap From GTA 5 to GTA 6, Says CD Projekt Red
cn_title: CDPR称《巫师4》将实现堪比《GTA 5》到《GTA 6》的飞跃
opus_summary: CDPR预计，《巫师3》到《巫师4》的跨越将可比《GTA 5》到《GTA 6》，并表示正努力改善游戏画面及几乎各个方面。《巫师4》目前以2028年发售为目标，CDPR还与PlayStation签订了营销协议，并计划扩大游戏的主流受众。

paragraphs.en: CD Projekt Red expects a leap between The Witcher 3 and 4 that is comparable to the one between GTA 5 and 6.
paragraphs.cn: CDPR预计，《巫师3》到《巫师4》的飞跃将堪比《GTA 5》到《GTA 6》的飞跃。

paragraphs.en: "We believe there's going to be a comparable leap between The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4 — I think so, yes," he said. "It's been 11 years, we are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game, so yes, you should expect us to make a much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4."
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「我们相信《巫师3》到《巫师4》会有一次类似的飞跃——是的，我是这么认为的。已经过去11年了，我们正在开发《巫师4》，让它看起来明显更出色，并在游戏几乎所有可能的方面都有所改进，所以是的，你们应该期待我们在《巫师3》和《巫师4》之间实现更大的飞跃。」

paragraphs.en: The leap between GTA 5 and 6 is pretty absurd. There's a significant number of more things to do, particularly for those interested in roleplaying as a criminal. You can steal drugs, rob banks, knock over virtually any store on the map, and so much more. A lot of these details were either reserved for scripted missions in GTA 5 or were underbaked as open-world activities, but are fully fleshed out for you to do however you want in GTA 6. Advancements in NPCs, interactivity, immersion, and the ability to enter hundreds of interiors also make GTA 6 feel a world apart from its predecessor.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 5》到《GTA 6》的飞跃相当惊人。游戏中多出了大量可做的事情，尤其是对那些有兴趣扮演罪犯的玩家来说。你可以偷毒品、抢银行、打劫地图上几乎任何一家商店，还有许多其他事情。在《GTA 5》中，这些细节有很多要么仅限于脚本任务，要么作为开放世界活动尚不成熟；但在《GTA 6》中，这些内容得到了充分完善，你可以随心所欲地进行。NPC、交互性和沉浸感方面的进步，以及能够进入数百处室内空间，也让《GTA 6》给人的感觉与前作截然不同。

paragraphs.en: Will The Witcher 4 also have tons of enterable interiors or deeper interactions with random NPCs? It's too soon to tell. It's possible that the leap for CD Projekt Red could come in a number of other ways, as The Witcher is a totally different world from GTA, after all. Maybe monster hunting will be more nuanced and involved than in The Witcher 3, similar to how GTA 6 has more engaging criminal activities.
paragraphs.cn: 《巫师4》是否也会有大量可进入的室内空间，或与随机NPC更深入的互动？现在下结论还为时过早。CDPR的飞跃可能会体现在其他多个方面，毕竟《巫师》与《GTA》是截然不同的世界。或许猎杀怪物会比《巫师3》中更加细致、更有参与感，就像《GTA 6》中有更引人入胜的犯罪活动一样。

paragraphs.en: CDPR also noted that it plans to find ways to expand the game to more mainstream audiences, like GTA 6 has. GTA 6 collaborated with major mainstream artists to create original music, in addition to bold marketing campaigns that made the game difficult to ignore.
paragraphs.cn: CDPR还表示，它计划寻找办法，让这款游戏像《GTA 6》一样吸引更多主流受众。《GTA 6》与知名主流艺术家合作创作了原创音乐，此外还开展了大胆的营销活动，让这款游戏难以被忽视。

paragraphs.en: The Witcher 4 is currently targeting a 2028 release , and we can probably expect more looks at the game next year. CDPR also noted that it has signed a marketing agreement with PlayStation for the game, which will also cover previous games and allow for opportunities with PlayStation Plus' services.
paragraphs.cn: 《巫师4》目前的目标是在2028年发售，我们或许可以期待明年看到更多游戏内容。CDPR还表示，它已就这款游戏与PlayStation签署营销协议，该协议还将涵盖之前的游戏，并带来利用PlayStation Plus服务的机会。
